author: T tvonruex
text: Charles and his team are simply the best we’ve ever worked with. On time, courteous and knowledgeable, they saved the day and fixed the illegal gray water connection into a freshwater pond and live stream our unlicensed (as we learned later) builder (Atkinson Development) made. Their septic installation is clean, works great and was finished for the promised price and within the promised time. Recommending them without any reservation.

author: Clint Hulett
text: Charles is always helpful and more than fair in price. He came out and saved us a good bit of money by repairing the drain field instead of having to replace the whole field. Highly recommend!

author: Billy Holland
text:
Franklin septic is the best option for anyone looking for a GREAT service at a reasonable cost they repaired my septic tank as well as stopped a water leak in my basement. Charles and Dalton are the real deal ..
They are very professional and knowledgeable on what it takes to resolve any plumbing issues..
As Ken Nugent would say One Call thats all…

author: Sav C
text: Had a routine cleaning. The guys got me scheduled quickly, were on time, worked quickly, and cleaned up when they were done. Very pleased with their service and highly recommend.

author: Robert Fox
text: I had an issue with my septic pump. I had the company that I had inspect my septic system when I bought the house come out to fix the issue.  They came out five times and each time, the pump kept failing. I finally realized I needed to contact a different company.  Thank you to reviewers on Google for your review of Franklin's Septic and Charles. He is the real deal. He came out and diagnosed the issue quickly. Then he walked through my house with me and pointed out some issues that I could correct myself in the future. His price to fix the issue was very reasonable. Thank you Charles for who you are and for your commitment to getting things right.
